name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset
description:
Drives the UEFN play-in-client play-test loop: start and stop a session, push content changes to the
connected server, and start, stop, and inspect the in-game match.

tools.description: Disconnect from and tear down the active play-in-client session.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.StopSession

tools.description: Stop the running in-game match on the connected server.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.StopGame

returnValue.title: ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome
returnValue.description: Whether the operation has completed or is still running.

tools.description: Upload the open project and launch a play-in-client session.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.StartSession

location.description: When set, launches via Play From Here: starts a match and spawns the player at this position once content finishes loading.
location.title: Vector

rotation.description: Spawn orientation applied with Location; ignored when Location is unset.
rotation.title: Rotator

returnValue.title: ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome
returnValue.description: Whether the operation has completed or is still running.

tools.description: Start the in-game match on the connected server.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.StartGame

returnValue.title: ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome
returnValue.description: Whether the operation has completed or is still running.

tools.description: Re-send modified project data to the connected server.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.PushChanges

bVerseOnly.description: Send only modified Verse source, skipping the asset cook a full push performs; much faster, so prefer it when only Verse changed.

returnValue.title: ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome
returnValue.description: Whether the operation has completed or is still running.

tools.description: Get the connection status of the play-in-client session.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.GetSessionStatus

tools.description: Get the state of the in-game match on the connected server.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.GetGameState

tools.description: Search the launched client's log for a pattern, case-insensitively.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.SessionToolset.GetClientLogEntries

pattern.description: A regular expression matched against each line (e.g. "frame [0-9]+").

maxResults.description: Maximum matches to return; unset means unlimited.

startLine.description: 0-indexed line to start from; negative starts at the first line.

returnValue.title: SessionToolsetClientLogEntries
returnValue.description: The matching lines in file order, plus the last line processed, for resuming a later search.

entries.description: The matching log lines, in file order.

lastEntryLine.description: Line number of the last line processed, for resuming a later search.
